sentences.en: They killed a goat as a sacrifice to the gods.
sentences.zh: 他们杀了一只羊来祭拜神明。

sentences.en: I sacrificed a lot in order to educate my daughter.
sentences.zh: 为了供女儿上学，我付出了很多。

sentences.en: He sacrificed his outstanding career to retain his dignity.
sentences.zh: 他放弃了自己辉煌的职业生涯以保持尊严。

senses.zh: 牺牲, 舍身 - 献祭, 供奉 - 祭品 -
